name: JsonTool
description: jq-lite in pure Python: query, pretty-print, validate and inspect JSON from files or stdin.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Extract a value by dot path (arrays indexed by number)

args.name: path
args.description: Dot path, e.g. summary.ok or items.0.name

commands.name: keys
commands.description: List object keys at a path (default: top level)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check a file is valid JSON (exit 0/1, prints error location)

commands.name: read
commands.description: Read adapter knowledge content (resource access contract)

provides.description: Query and inspect JSON without jq installed.
